suggestions.pricingPrompt:
Create a SaaS pricing comparison graphic.
Place three cards side by side labeled Starter, Pro, and Business.
Include the price, key features, and a CTA button on each card.
Use a cohesive theme color and a clean, modern web design.
suggestions.workflowPrompt:
Create a single slide with a workflow diagram explaining invoice processing.
Arrange five steps from left to right: Receipt, OCR, Approval, Payment, and Archive. Add a short description to each step.
Add an icon to every step and use one cohesive theme color with a polished design.
suggestions.posterPrompt:
Create a brand poster suitable for recruiting or event promotion.
Make a large headline the focal point, then organize a subheading, event information or service name, and a short description.
Use typography and geometric shapes instead of photography.
Give it a modern, design-forward visual identity suited to a startup.
